tests.name: ubjson_valueless_array_within_limit
tests.intent: Verify that an optimized UBJSON array of type Z within the per-array and global input limits is successfully read.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_array_excessive_per_container
tests.intent: Verify that an optimized UBJSON array exceeding max_valueless_container_size (1048576) on its own throws out_of_range.

tests.name: ubjson_noop_array_empty_count
tests.intent: Verify that a no-op optimized UBJSON array reports 0 elements and does not throw out_of_range even with a huge declared count.

tests.name: ubjson_to_ubjson_fallback_writer
tests.intent: Verify that to_ubjson writes unoptimized arrays when valueless elements exceed the threshold so it remains readable.

tests.name: ubjson_cumulative_valueless_limit
tests.intent: Verify that multiple small valueless arrays accumulate towards the global input limit and trigger out_of_range when exceeded.

tests.name: ubjson_sax_parse_noop_events
tests.intent: Verify via SAX parse that a no-op optimized array emits start_array(0) and end_array without intervening value events.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_type_t
tests.intent: Verify handling of valueless type 'T' (true) arrays under the new limits.

tests.name: ubjson_valueless_type_f
tests.intent: Verify handling of valueless type 'F' (false) arrays under the new limits.

tests.name: ubjson_typed_array_with_payload
tests.intent: Verify that typed arrays with payloads (like int32 'l') are bounded by input size and do not trigger valueless element rules.

tests.name: bjdata_valueless_type_rejected
tests.intent: Verify that BJData format correctly handles/rejects valueless or excluded types where appropriate.

tests.name: ubjson_to_ubjson_small_null_array
tests.intent: Verify that small null arrays are written in optimized form by to_ubjson.

tests.name: ubjson_unoptimized_array_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that unoptimized UBJSON arrays round-trip successfully.

tests.name: ubjson_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify that an empty standard UBJSON array parses correctly.

tests.name: ubjson_nested_valueless_arrays
tests.intent: Verify nested optimized valueless arrays are checked cumulatively.

tests.name: ubjson_invalid_container_marker
tests.intent: Verify error handling when an invalid container header is encountered.

tests.name: ubjson_to_ubjson_bool_arrays
tests.intent: Verify writing and reading of boolean arrays via to_ubjson and from_ubjson.

tests.name: ubjson_object_with_valueless_values
tests.intent: Verify that objects containing null values are not restricted by valueless array limits since objects have keys.

tests.name: ubjson_bytes_read_scaling_limit
tests.intent: Verify that larger inputs allow slightly more valueless elements proportional to chars_read.

tests.name: ubjson_to_ubjson_explicit_params
tests.intent: Verify to_ubjson invocation with explicit route parameters for optimize and allow_invalid flags.

tests.name: ubjson_malformed_count_type
tests.intent: Verify reader behavior when a valueless array count specifier type is missing or invalid.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Trigger line 3769 by having chars_read large enough that the saturation branch of the limit calculation is evaluated.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Trigger line 3772 (charge_valueless_elements returns false) by inputting a valueless array whose count exceeds limit - valueless_elements, triggering out_of_range.408.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Trigger line 3871 by causing charge_valueless_elements to return false during array parsing, resulting in container_too_large exception.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger line 3881 by passing a malformed array header or context that causes enter_array to fail (returning false).

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Trigger writing of multiple large valueless typed arrays via to_ubjson to instantiate valueless_array_fits and valueless_elements_written.
